name: kbd
usage: # Kbd A key or a key combination. ## Usage ```gx Esc Ctrl + K ``` `KbdGroup` keeps the keys of one shortcut on one line. ## Do - Write the key as it is printed on the keyboard. - Put one key in one `Kbd`. ## Don't - Do not use a kbd for a button. It does not take a click. - Do not put a sentence in a kbd. ## Keyboard | Key | Action | | --- | --- | | None | The component is static. |
